description: Search regulatory updates from financial regulators across 20 jurisdictions — news, enforcement actions, consultations, policy statements, guidance, final rules, speeches and warnings, from 2011 to today. Filter by regulator, jurisdiction, topic, sector, firm type, content type, urgency, importance and date. Use published_after to answer "what changed recently"; use significance_min (4+) to cut routine noise. Returns compact records with a canonical regmonitoring.com URL for each — cite it. Call regmonitoring_get_update for the full text and analysis of any single result.

firm_types.description: Types of firm affected. Records tagged "All Firms" are cross-cutting and match every firm-type filter, so filtering by "Asset Manager" also returns updates that apply to everyone.

has_analysis.description: Only records carrying AI analysis (about 89% of the corpus).

jurisdictions.description: Lowercase jurisdiction codes, e.g. ["uk","us","eu"]. Call regmonitoring_get_taxonomy for the valid list — guessing "UK" or "United Kingdom" returns nothing.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging.

published_after.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. This is how you answer "what changed this week" — no separate tool is needed.

query.description: Free-text search over title and summary. All words must appear (case-insensitive). Omit to browse by filters alone.

regulators.description: Lowercase regulator codes, e.g. ["fca","sec","esma"]. See regmonitoring_get_taxonomy.

significance_min.description: Minimum importance, 1 (routine) to 5 (major). Every record is scored, so this is the most reliable way to cut noise. 4+ is "worth a compliance officer's attention".

sort.description: Default "newest". "relevance" ranks by query match and falls back to newest when no query is given.

topics.description: Regulatory themes. Values are exact, e.g. "AML / Financial Crime".

urgency.description: Urgency. NOTE: about 35% of records have no urgency set, and filtering on this excludes all of them. Prefer significance_min unless urgency is specifically what you want.

name: regmonitoring_search_updates
title: Search regulatory updates
